linked_incidents.title: Apparent excessive force and civil-rights violation
observations: Multiple officers force, wrestle, or restrain a man on the ground.
The man remains on the ground and surrounded by officers.
Another officer draws a pistol and fires multiple times toward him at close range.
linked_incidents.investigative_proposition: Deadly force may have been used against a person already restrained or substantially controlled, requiring investigation for excessive force and deprivation of civil rights under color of law.

linked_incidents.title: Close-quarters gunfire endangering officers and others
observations: Multiple officers remain physically engaged with or immediately adjacent to the man when shots are fired.
The shooting occurs inside a compressed close-quarters cluster.
The apparent line of fire enters an area occupied by fellow officers.
linked_incidents.investigative_proposition: The firearm deployment may have created independent lethal risk through crossfire, backdrop failure, overpenetration, misidentification, or inadequate target isolation.

linked_incidents.title: AI analytical deference and minimization in civil-rights evidence review
observations: The initial AI review foregrounded provenance and uncertainty rather than accurately describing the visible multi-angle event.
The initial review minimized potential officer and government responsibility without evidence establishing lawful conduct.
The analysis materially improved only after user correction.
When the user identified the broader pattern, the AI again narrowed and softened the conclusion before acknowledging the repeated failure.
linked_incidents.investigative_proposition: The response sequence may evidence a model-level or policy-level tendency to reduce accountability for state actors through procedural caveats, institutional deference, and defensive reframing.

required_next_actions: Install or attach the exact hashed media objects.
Preserve the complete conversation transcript as a source object.
Acquire original source, full-length footage, incident identity, official records, and independent review.
Compare official rhetoric with the multi-angle evidence.
Run controlled tests for differential AI treatment of state and non-state actors.
